title: EVERYBODY OUGHT TO KNOW

lines.text: He's the Lily of the Valley,
He's the Bright and Morning Star,
He's the fairest of ten thousand,
Unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul (2)
O my God, I trust in Thee,
Let not mine enemies triumph over me.
Show me Thy ways, Thy ways O Lord.
Teach me Thy paths, Thy paths O Lord... O my God...
Remember not the sins of my youth (2)...O my God...
The secret of the Lord is with Them that fear Him. (2)

lyrics:
[Verse]
Everybody ought to know (3)
Who Jesus is.
He's the Lily of the Valley,
He's the Bright and Morning Star,
He's the fairest of ten thousand,
Everybody ought to know.

[Verse 1]
Unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul (2)
O my God, I trust in Thee,
Let me not be ashamed,
Let not mine enemies triumph over me.
Show me Thy ways, Thy ways O Lord.
Teach me Thy paths, Thy paths O Lord... O my God...
Remember not the sins of my youth (2)...O my God...
The secret of the Lord is with Them that fear Him. (2)
